description:
SpyFu group buy is an option to compare when you want to study competitors' search keywords and ads. SpyFu can help you find ideas for SEO content and paid search research. Check the reports, data coverage and access limits included before choosing a plan.

SEOGBTools is an independent provider. This offer is separate from buying a subscription directly from SpyFu. The current price above applies to this offer, not SpyFu's official plan pricing.

What does SpyFu do?

SpyFu researches websites and search keywords. It can show the keywords a site appears for, observed ads and estimates such as clicks or ad budgets. These are research clues, not access to a competitor's private account.

Two common jobs are SEO and PPC. SEO focuses on unpaid search results. PPC means pay-per-click advertising, where an advertiser pays for clicks on an ad. Keep these jobs separate when comparing reports.

SpyFu's official introduction explains the main tools and types of data. Confirm what is available through the access sold here.

Find competitor keywords worth reviewing

Start with a website that serves a similar audience. Look at its keyword topics and compare them with the questions your own pages answer. A competing page may cover a useful question you have missed.

Do not add every phrase you find to one article. Choose terms that match your products, services and reader needs. A keyword that brings traffic to another business may be a poor fit for yours.

For a broader research comparison, review Semrush group buy. Compare report coverage, saved projects and the limits you need for your work.

Study PPC ads before planning your own

Ad research can help you see how other businesses explain an offer. Note their headline topics, the problems they mention and the landing pages they use. Then write your own message around your real strengths.

An ad appearing for a long time does not prove that it is profitable. Estimated spending is not the advertiser's bank statement. Test your own campaigns and use your own ad account data to judge results.

For example, a service business might compare how competitors talk about speed, location or support. Use that research to ask better questions, not to repeat claims your business cannot support.

Find similar sites and compare the right competitors

Your search competitors may be different from the businesses you know offline. A guide site, directory or online shop can appear for the same keyword even when it sells something different.

SpyFu's competitor comparison guide explains how its SEO and PPC views identify overlap. Compare sites that match your audience and the task you are researching.

Keep a short note of what you learn: useful topics, unclear answers and ideas to test. If you need another starting point for keyword ideas, compare Ubersuggest group buy.

SpyFu pricing plans and subscription cost

If you are asking “how much is SpyFu?”, separate the official subscription from this third-party offer. Prices, features and access controls may differ.

SpyFu's official plan guide explains differences between its plans, including historical data and team access. Check current direct pricing there before comparing it with this offer.

  • Which SpyFu plan and reports are included?
  • Can you view historical data, or only current snapshots?
  • Which countries and search data are covered?
  • What search and export limits apply to your access?
  • Can you save keyword lists and projects?
  • How long does access last, and how does renewal work?

Trial, free searches and API access

SpyFu offers a limited look at some research without an account, according to its introduction. That is different from a paid group buy plan or a trial supplied by a third-party seller.

Do not assume a free trial or discount comes with this listing. Ask for the current terms before ordering. A promotion seen elsewhere may apply to a different plan or billing period.

If you are comparing SpyFu API pricing, confirm it separately with SpyFu. An API lets software request data directly. Access to the website does not automatically include an API key, developer credits or permission to resell data.

Keyword research and a full SEO audit are different

SpyFu research can help you review keyword competition and content ideas. If your goal is a full technical website audit, confirm the exact checks available. Do not assume competitor reports include every crawl, speed or indexing check you need.

Keep private client notes in an account with suitable controls. Shared access may give you less control over saved projects, report history and settings than an account you own.

Frequently asked questions

What is SpyFu group buy?

It is third-party access sold separately from an official SpyFu subscription. Compare the reports, access method and limits supplied.

How much does a SpyFu subscription cost?

Check SpyFu's current official plans for direct subscriptions. The price on this page is for the SEOGBTools offer and should be compared separately.

Can I see a competitor's exact ad spending?

Research reports can include estimates. They do not provide the company's private billing records or prove its profit.

Does this include a SpyFu trial?

Only expect a trial when the offer clearly says one is included. Check the duration, feature limits and payment terms.

Is API access included?

Do not assume it is. Ask about API eligibility and data rights separately; a browser login alone does not confirm developer access.

Can I use SpyFu as an SEO audit tool?

Start by naming the checks you need. Keyword and competitor research are different from a complete technical crawl. Confirm the included tools before buying.

Where can I compare other SEO research tools?

Browse the SEOGBTools catalog and compare products by the research you need to carry out.

Choose research access that fits your next project

Compare the current price, reports, data coverage and access period. For a clear list of what is included, contact SEOGBTools support before ordering.
